|errata_history={{Card errata/General Solo (V)}}
This is the original printed text (version 1 of 3). The current text is [[General Solo (V) (Remastered)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 0 release<ref name="eh1351-gsolo-0">[http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-large_images_postreset.tar.bz2 December 2014 Holotable large-image archive, Set 0 Light].</ref>. Dated 2014 (Virtual Set 0); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of General Solo (V) first published}} Text: “[Pilot] 3. During battle, may use 1 Force to play an Interrupt from your Reserve Deck (then place that card out of play). Once per turn, may ▲ a non-Interrupt card with “door” in game text.” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[General Solo (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee Current Rulings<ref name="eh1351-gsolo-1">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1180105#p1180105 Players Committee Current Rulings, 7 April 2018].</ref>. First published 7 April 2018. The PC card image with this text and the “E” mark followed on 9 July 2018 (Holotable commit 6d7b3a4). Text: “[Pilot] 3. During battle, may use 1 Force to ▲ an Interrupt, play it, then place that card out of play. Once per turn, may ▲ a non-Interrupt card with “door” in game text.” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “▲”, “, play it,”; words removed: “)”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[General Solo (V) (Remastered)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-gsolo-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/generalsolo.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “[Pilot] 3. During battle, may use 1 Force to ▲ an Interrupt, play it, then place that card out of play. Once per turn, may ▲ a non-Interrupt card with “door” in game text.” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
